answer_text: The circuit has positive feedback instead of negative feedback. Fix: swap opamp inputs.

choices.A: Feedback network has too much attenuation. Fix: increase feedback resistor.
choices.B: Op-amp is saturating due to insufficient supply voltage. Fix: increase VDD.
choices.C: Capacitor is missing at critical node. Fix: add compensation capacitor.
choices.D: Load capacitance is too large. Fix: add buffer stage.
choices.E: Resistor values are incorrect. Fix: recalculate R1 based on desired gain.
choices.F: Circuit is oscillating due to insufficient phase margin. Fix: add lead compensation.
choices.G: Input bias current causes DC offset. Fix: add input bias current compensation.
choices.H: Op-amp bandwidth is insufficient. Fix: select faster op-amp.
choices.I: Common-mode rejection is inadequate. Fix: use fully differential topology.
choices.J: The circuit has positive feedback instead of negative feedback. Fix: swap opamp inputs.
